mission_09: For online meta-update: adapt params on current task (inner loop), compute query loss gradient, update meta-params: params = params - meta_lr * meta_gradient. This happens after each task, not after a batch.
Regret = cumulative_loss - best_fixed_model_loss. Average regret = regret / t. Sublinear regret means regret grows slower than O(t).

For adaptive LR: track recent losses over a window. If recent loss > historical average, increase LR (need to learn faster). If recent loss < average, decrease LR. For experience replay, maintain a buffer of past tasks. When a new task arrives, add it to the buffer (evict oldest if full), then sample a subset for replay training.
